messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@finstack.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security gate inventory & acceptance runway — Finstack MAP

Hi Naomi / team,

Thanks for the MAP draft — overall looks good. Before we lock the schedule with procurement, can we confirm the exact security gates you expect to be completed prior to P0 acceptance? Two things that are blocking our internal approvals:

1) SOC 2 evidence bundle — we need a short inventory (folders + sample artifacts). What format do you prefer? PDF index + links is fine.
2) SIG / CAIQ — our security team would like a gap log and timeline for closure (which items are must-have vs. lower priority).

Also, a DPA redline question: our legal team wants clarity on data retention for logs and user content. The current DPA shows a 365-day default for logs; do you support shorter retention (90 days) for production tenants? If so, what operational steps are required (config change vs. product limitations)?

Goal: if we can get the gate inventory + clear acceptance criteria by EOD Friday (May 21), procurement will target a PO and we can begin the integration sprint week of May 31.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Product Security Manager, Finstack

Attachments: Finstack_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP milestones / owners)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security gate inventory & acceptance runway — Finstack MAP

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide the SOC 2 inventory + a prioritized SIG/CAIQ gap log by EOD Friday; and yes, we can support a 90-day retention configuration for logs for production tenants under a configuration flag (no code change required). Details below.

SOC 2 evidence bundle (what we'll deliver) — suggested package:
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (top-level summary: scope, control owners, latest report date)
- Evidence index (spreadsheet with links to artifacts; we will include sample runbooks, change logs, and incident response items)
- Access instructions (temporary link with read-only view + contact for questions)

SIG / CAIQ gap log (what we'll deliver) — we'll provide a spreadsheet called SIG-CAIQ-gaplog.xlsx that includes:
- Control ID, short description, current status, remediation owner, ETA, must-have vs. nice-to-have flag
- For items that are material to acceptance (encrypted at-rest keys, KMS integration, tenant-level data segregation) we'll mark them MUST and include a short mitigation plan or timeline.

DPA / retention question — technical details:
- Logs: We support per-tenant log retention configuration. Default in platform is 365 days for aggregated logs; we can set tenant-level to 90 days. Operational note: retention is applied in the logging pipeline (config toggle + policy update). We will need a signed amendment in the MAP (simple clause) that documents the retention setting and the effective date.
- User content: Our standard policy for customer-controlled user content residence depends on deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). For hosted tenants we can configure shorter retention for derived telemetry, but primary user content retention is typically agreed in the DPA addendum.

Next steps / who is doing what by Friday EOD:
- Naomi (me): SOC2_Summary.pdf + evidence index links (deliverable in Drive).
- Marissa: finalize the SIG-CAIQ gap log and mark MUST vs NICE-TO-HAVE.
- Karthik: validate the log retention change path and write the operational steps.
- Alicia: confirm which artifacts Finstack needs as "must have" vs "deferred" for procurement sign-off.

I'll attach the working documents in Drive and upload SOC2_Summary.pdf by 3pm PST today; Marissa and Karthik will put their updates in the sheet.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Alicia — I've started the SIG-CAIQ gap log in the attached spreadsheet and added a first-pass prioritization. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Tenant isolation: we consider tenant-level logical separation (namespaces + ACLs) as MUST for P0. Physical separation (dedicated hardware) is optional and can be scoped under Dedicated deployment conversation.
- KMS / key management: MUST — we require Finstack to confirm KMS key ownership model (Redwood-managed or customer-managed). If you choose customer-managed keys (CMKs), we will include a short onboarding checklist that adds ~7 business days to the timeline for KMS setup and rotation policies.
- SOC 2 artifacts we will surface in the evidence index: control runbooks (infra change control), incident postmortems (redacted), backup verification reports, and the auditor's scope statement.

I've flagged 6 SIG items as MUST. For the rest we'll propose mitigations where we can offer compensating controls in the MAP (e.g., additional monitoring windows, access reviews).

I've uploaded SIG-CAIQ-gaplog.xlsx to the shared Drive folder and linked it in the MAP. Naomi — Karthik and I left comments on the rows where we need a short technical note.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

Alicia / Naomi / Marissa — quick operational detail on retention and acceptance checkpoints, per Naomi's ask: 

1) Enabling 90-day log retention for a hosted tenant:
- Action: change tenant retention policy flag in the control plane (no code deploy).
- Owner: Redwood Ops (we will coordinate a maintenance window < 30 minutes for policy rollout).
- Audit: we will provide a verification report showing retention policy applied and a sample deletion event for older logs after 90 days.

2) Acceptance criteria matrix (proposed final P0 gate):
- SOC2 summary + evidence index uploaded to shared Drive — item verified by Finstack security.
- SIG-CAIQ MUST items closed or have compensating controls documented and accepted.
- DPA signed including retention amendment (if 90-day retention requested).
- KMS model agreed and KMS onboarding checklist complete (if CMK requested).

3) Timeline impact (if Finstack requests CMK + 90-day retention): +7 business days for KMS onboarding, +1 business day for retention policy application. Without CMK the timeline stays as proposed (integration sprint week of May 31).

I'll post a short runbook (retention-change-steps.txt) to the Drive by EOD tomorrow and add a row to the MAP spreadsheet with the owners and ETA.

-Karthik
